focused_site.type: Fixed price for the exact listed scope. The signed quote identifies pages and deliverables. Any extra is separately priced before signing or through a written change request.
focused_site.included_pages: Up to 15 purposeful marketing pages, researched, written and designed around your business. 2 original articles or guides are included within that total.
focused_site.page_scope: Up to 15 agreed marketing pages, each with its own web address. Plan the right mix of core pages, service explanations, project stories and customer questions; the 2 included articles or guides count inside this total, not on top. Several sections on one page count as one page. Related pages may share a layout family while their content serves a distinct purpose. Supplied plain policy pages are separate. We agree the page list before booking; unused slots do not require filler pages and additional pages receive a separate quote.
focused_site.copy: Complete website writing for every agreed page: we write from your verified business facts or refine your rough drafts into clear, persuasive copy. Essential FAQs help customers make a confident decision, with more service-specific depth in the larger packages. Content follows the question, with no word-count ceiling or padding. You approve facts and claims; original field research and legal drafting are separate.
focused_site.seo_foundation: Research your service topics and customer questions, with a content-gap review of up to 3 relevant search competitors. A keyword-to-page intent map shapes every agreed page. Includes titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, canonical/crawl/sitemap checks and factual structured data where appropriate; analytics and Search Console connection with approved access and reviewed privacy. Up to 5 prioritized content ideas, with the audience question and suggested next step for each. No ranking or traffic guarantee.
focused_site.creative: Developed custom art direction and purposeful interface animation give each service a confident, cohesive presentation. 3 custom launch graphics plus 3 finished promotional graphics (6 distinct designs total), 6 supplied-photo edits, a practical brand sheet, cleaned existing-logo exports and a social avatar. 3 finished promotional graphics, ready to publish for agreed campaign uses. Each is a distinct design; resizing the same design does not create another graphic. Final image exports are included; reusable editing templates and presentation decks are separate. Mobile and reduced-motion treatment is included. One browser-tab icon and one default branded social link-sharing image from approved assets are included separately, with page metadata checks. Extra variants, full identity redesign and original photography are separate. A custom animated hero or 3D centerpiece is separate.
focused_site.functionality: Two distinct contact forms, each with up to six agreed fields, one receiving destination and one confirmation state; basic spam defense and save/notification/confirmation checks. Forms collect ordinary business inquiries. Sensitive personal information and file uploads require a separate assessment. Up to 2 agreed links or compatible standard embeds for client-ready booking or newsletter services. External account configuration and automation are separate. Your custom website comes with editable source and content files. You or your chosen developer can update the code, check the changes and publish them. We confirm the technology, compatible hosting and who will handle future updates before booking.
focused_site.revisions: Two combined feedback rounds across the approved website: one design review and one staging review. In-scope defects are corrected separately. A new direction, extra page or feature requires an agreed change quote.
focused_site.handoff: Within five business days of paid completion or reconciled termination, receive the existing paid website source, approved content/assets, dependency and non-secret configuration files, a start-here guide, build/publishing instructions, license/account map, dated checks and known unfinished items in a delivery folder or ZIP. Generated hosting files are included where applicable. Connected services and credentials require their separate account setup or secure transfer; a ZIP does not migrate them automatically. This handoff is separate from the 30-day defect-correction window. Client-controlled accounts remain accessible throughout.
focused_site.correction: 30 calendar days after launch for defects against accepted scope. New requests and external-provider changes are separate. Paid handoff is not withheld until this period ends.
focused_site.delivery_target: Your written scope sets production, review and launch dates around the agreed page map, content research, creative work and available capacity. The schedule reserves launch checks, source handoff and defect-correction capacity.
